title: Snake / 貪食蛇
description: Complete offline single HTML Snake game. Food, growth, score, wall/self collision, pause/restart, keyboard and mobile swipe/buttons, fullscreen. Deterministic stepping and visible state hooks. Emits game-score CustomEvent so an external scoreboard can attach without replacing game logic.
usage: Copy index.html. To add a leaderboard copy scoreboard.js beside it, add <script src="scoreboard.js"></script> after the game script, then Scoreboard.attach({selector:"main",key:"snake-scores"}).
verification: Chromium fixture acceptance 2026-10-02: controls/persistence/offline and canonical game captures exercised. Full-board wins and physical Safari unverified. Fixture evidence is not future model-delivery evidence.
